title: Beware the Mad Dentist
overview: Ame is restrained by the Mad Dentist and is about to undergo dangerous cavity treatment. It's a desperate crisis! But is there a secret in Ame's mouth...?

title: Ame's Cavity
overview: Caries, a cavity, remodels Ame's teeth without asking and pushes her around. Seeing that Ame can't fit in with her friends, Caries tries to solve it with her specialty: DIY.

title: TV Raising Project
overview: Ame is happy that her baby tooth fell out. But that was Caries' precious TV! Caries carefully nurtures the newly growing tooth, eventually growing it into a giant TV, but...

title: Is the White Powder Dangerous?
overview: Ame is banned from eating sweets by her mom. Unable to watch Caries suffer from not eating sweets, her friend Mikan secretly gives them sugar, but they get involved in unexpected trouble.

title: Pushed Around by Him
overview: When Ame wakes up, Caries and a mysterious fish, Harold, are flirting inside her mouth! Ame doesn't accept Harold, who claims to be Caries' boyfriend. However, Caries is head over heels for Harold...

title: Catch the Tooth Thief
overview: Believing the rumor of the Tooth Fairy who "exchanges lost teeth for money," Ame and friends sleep with teeth under their pillows. But they were all stolen! Caries stands up for the sake of the children.

title: The Dentist Isn't Scary
overview: Mom took Ame to... the dentist!? If the cavity is found, it's game over! Ame and Caries panic and frantically clean up Caries' room, but...
